name: Ecwid
one_liner: Ecwid is an e-commerce platform that offers a REST API for store data, webhooks, and storefront customization.
auth_notes: Secret token (`secret_token`) is only limited by the app permissions, so it must not be used in the publically available code.

gate.process: Create a custom app in the Ecwid admin to obtain access tokens

evidence.snippet: Ecwid uses OAuth 2.0 to provide secure access to the store data for public apps.
Secret token (`secret_token`) is only limited by the app permissions, so it must not be used in the publically available code.
Only stores on paid plans can access API.
When created, custom applications automatically get default access scopes and both access tokens unlocking some REST API requests.
All requests to Ecwid REST API require an access token.
